name: codex-rate-limit-guard
description: Supervise Codex CLI runs and retry transient 429/500 failures after cleaning up child processes.

interface.shortDescription: Retry transient Codex CLI rate-limit failures.
interface.longDescription: Runs Codex exec under a local supervisor that detects 429/500 and rate-limit failures, stops the process tree, waits with backoff, and resumes the latest session.
defaultPrompt: Run this task with rate-limit retry protection.
Configure the retry count and cooldown for Codex.
Explain how to resume a guarded Codex run.
